result.title: XuanJian-DINOSAR: A SAR Foundation Model Based on Global and Local Semantic Consistency
result.summary: Self-supervised pre-training on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery enables transferable representations, but the optical-SAR domain gap and speckle perturbations limit representation stability. Most SAR foundation models use masked image modeling (MIM) through pixel reconstruction or structural feature prediction, which is sensitive to speckle or relies on predefined operators. Joint modeling of cross-view semantics and perturbation stability at corresponding spatial locations remains underexplored. We propose XuanJian-DINOSAR, a SAR foundation model based on global and local semantic consistency. We curate over 360K publicly available SAR target chips, detection images, and scene images spanning diverse targets, scenes, and sensors, and adapt an optically pre-trained DINOv2 model to SAR through self-supervised learning. The framework combines DINO global semantic self-distillation, iBOT local masked modeling, and KoLeo feature-distribution regularization to learn globally discriminative and locally structure-aware representations. We introduce a local semantic consistency branch tailored to SAR intensity statistics and coherent imaging characteristics. Shared geometric transformations produce spatially aligned teacher weak views and student strong views. Intensity transformations and Gamma multiplicative speckle perturbations are applied to student views, while a cosine consistency loss aligns patch tokens at corresponding locations, promoting stability under radiometric perturbations. This objective complements the cross-region and cross-scale semantic consistency of DINOv2 multi-crop training, jointly enforcing global and local semantic consistency. Experiments on multiple downstream classification and detection datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on most evaluation metrics, validating the generality and transferability of the learned representations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建约36万张SAR图像，将光学预训练的DINOv2适配到SAR，结合DINO全局自蒸馏、iBOT局部掩码建模与KoLeo正则，并加入针对斑点噪声的局部语义一致性分支做自监督预训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对空间对应位置patch token施加余弦一致性损失、以抵抗强度与斑点扰动的做法，可供核查作为保持视觉latent状态稳定与局部细节的训练约束；但论文只做SAR表示预训练，无推理过程或latent推理，联系停留在表示训练层面。
